summary: Confirmed all 46 estimates: four originality contrasts (Table 18, PDF p. 26), 30 global-diversity contrasts (Tables 11-13, PDF pp. 21-22), and 12 diversity-slope contrasts (Table 17, PDF p. 25; supplementary confidence intervals, degrees of freedom and p-values on PDF p. 8). Read the entire 1,169-line markdown, including all appendices and supplementary sections, and directly extracted every cited PDF page. All 169 recorded numeric fields and p-value bounds have matching source quotations; all 145 source quotations match their cited pages after whitespace normalization. Independent PDF row checks confirmed the outcome, model column, arm orientation, sign and value for every estimate. All 59 mechanical-report flags are false positives caused by trailing-zero formatting: for example, 1.21 equals the printed 1.210000, and -0.06 equals -0.060000. The quotations preserve the printed precision. The study-wide count of 844 people is supported by Table 2; analysis-specific people counts are unreported and correctly null. The 3,271 originality observations and 362 evolution observations are full-model counts of outputs and idea pools, respectively, as explicitly identified in the extraction notes; they are not people or two-arm counts. Confirmed question, construct, measure, unit, direction, AI availability, timing, within-person design, comparison type and uncertainty basis. The control supplies human examples, supporting ai_vs_active; randomized repeated conditions support paired; originality uses participant random intercepts, while global and evolution diversity use set-level uncertainty. Evolution concerns successive participants in response chains with AI examples available, not work after AI removal. No additional eligible full-sample two-arm contrast was found under rules 4-6. Local-distance and AI-adoption tables report moderator-conditional coefficients or percentile-specific contrasts, and creativity evolution supplies only an omnibus test. Table 17 lower-order condition coefficients describe trial-zero levels rather than full-sample levels. Unprinted arm means, SDs and counts remain null; plotted values were not inferred. The low-exposure condition-label inconsistency between Section 5.2 and Table 12 is already documented; the extracted values correctly follow the explicit table rows.
